class.name: JRPGManagedAddon
class.brief_description: Installs and upgrades the Talewright managed addon (res://addons/talewright) in the editor.
class.description: The managed addon holds the GDScript and scene sources Talewright's JRPG tools build games with. Its files are embedded in the editor and copied into the project; [code]addon.cfg[/code] in the addon folder records the installed version and the SHA-256 hash of every installed file. Installing again upgrades the addon: a file is replaced only while it is exactly as it was installed, so files you changed are kept and listed in the report. A file with the same name that the addon did not install is never overwritten. Editor only. The Claude bridge exposes it as the [code]jrpg_addon_status[/code] and [code]jrpg_addon_install[/code] tools.

method.name: get_embedded_files
method.description: Returns the paths, relative to the addon folder, of the files embedded in this editor.

method.name: get_embedded_version
method.description: Returns the version of the addon embedded in this editor: the addon format number and a hash of its content.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] with [code skip-lint]directory[/code], [code]embedded_version[/code], [code]installed_version[/code] (empty when the addon is not installed) and [code]files[/code]: one [Dictionary] per embedded file with its [code]path[/code] and [code]state[/code]: [code]missing[/code], [code]current[/code] (same as this editor's), [code]outdated[/code] (as installed by an older version) or [code]modified[/code] (changed since it was installed).

method.name: install
method.description: Installs or upgrades the addon in [param directory]. Returns a [Dictionary] with the [code]version[/code] installed and the lists of paths [code]added[/code], [code]replaced[/code], [code]unchanged[/code] and [code]kept_modified[/code]. The editor's file system is rescanned when [param directory] is inside the project.
